aggregation_stories.title: Walmart launches Tap to Pay in all Hawaii stores | Business
aggregation_stories.summary: Walmart has introduced its Tap to Pay contactless payment option in all nine of its stores across Hawaii. This new feature allows customers to make purchases using credit/debit cards, phones, or smartwatches, aiming to streamline the checkout process. Hawaii is among the first 13 states to receive this rollout, with Walmart planning to expand Tap to Pay to all U.S. Walmart and Sam's Club locations by the end of 2026.
